confidence_notes: Food and coffee anchors follow current Cairo cost-of-living aggregates. Alcohol data are thinner: the cocktail estimate follows a recent crowd-sourced downtown-club price at roughly 3.5 times domestic draft beer, while the wine glass is estimated at about twice beer because a comparable restaurant glass price was not available. Accommodation is a holistic estimate without live listing checks and varies by district and season.
comparable_city_reasoning: No city analogue used; food and drink estimates are based on recent Cairo price aggregates, while accommodation reflects general knowledge of budget lodging in a large North African capital.
